ops.title: The verified recipe to bring up the BlueBubbles server + Private API on the Tahoe guest — what the old scripts got wrong and the exact working steps
ops.body:
Proved live 2026-07-05 on the bluebubbles guest (macOS 26.5 Tahoe); hermes-agent went `active` with `helper_connected:true`. Codified in `scripts/bluebubbles-setup.sh` + `packer/bluebubbles.pkr.hcl` (commit c199460). The OLD bring-up was DOUBLY broken and never actually worked:

1. **Dead cask.** `brew install --cask bluebubbles-server` does not exist. BlueBubbles ships as a GitHub-release **DMG**: `https://github.com/BlueBubblesApp/bluebubbles-server/releases/download/v1.9.9/BlueBubbles-1.9.9-arm64.dmg` (sha256 `fafd650c883f52e7494a6625e45249f2144d197378a4d57143ccf6198bb2e862`). Install = curl → `hdiutil attach` → `cp -R BlueBubbles.app /Applications` → detach → `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine`. Bundle id `com.BlueBubbles.BlueBubbles-Server`, Team `WPV275H8W7`.
2. **Wrong config file.** BlueBubbles ignores `config.json`; it stores settings in a SQLite **`~/Library/Application Support/bluebubbles-server/config.db`** (a `config` name/value table). Seed by: launch once (creates the db) → quit → `sqlite3 UPDATE config SET value=…` for `password`, `enable_private_api`=1, `auto_start`=1, `socket_port`=1234, `proxy_service`=dynamic-dns (kills BlueBubbles' default public Cloudflare tunnel — we expose it via `tailscale serve` only). Webhooks live in a separate `webhook` table; hermes-agent registers its own webhook over the REST API, so DON'T seed one. `authorized_handles` is NOT a BB setting (the iMessage allowlist is hermes-side, `BLUEBUBBLES_ALLOW_ALL_USERS`/allowlist).

**The Private-API helper (DYLD injection into Messages) needs THREE things, not just SIP-off:**
- SIP disabled (the cirruslabs base already is).
- **Library validation disabled**: `sudo defaults write /Library/Preferences/com.apple.security.libraryvalidation.plist DisableLibraryValidation -bool true` — this is the piece everyone misses. Needs a REBOOT (AMFI reads it at boot). Baked in the packer image so a fresh guest has it. Without it the log shows `[MessagesDylibPlugin] Injecting Messages Helper DYLIB… Killing process: Messages` on a loop but `helper_connected` stays false.
- **TCC Accessibility in the SYSTEM db**, not the user db. The old `grant_tcc` wrote `kTCCServiceAccessibility` to `~/…/TCC.db` — INEFFECTIVE on Big Sur+. It (and FDA `kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAllFiles`) must go in `/Library/Application Support/com.apple.TCC/TCC.db` (sudo). Compute the csreq blob from the installed app (`codesign -d -r-` → SecRequirement… → `X'<hex>'`, single-quoted blob literal — `X"…"` is a SQLite syntax error). Kick `system/com.apple.tccd` after.
- Messages.app must be RUNNING (signed in) for the helper to inject.

**Runs as ROOT but the app/db/session are the auto-login admin's** — retarget with `as_gui() { launchctl asuser "$GUI_UID" sudo -u "$GUI_USER" "$@"; }` (GUI_USER from `stat -f%Su /dev/console`) for `open`/`osascript`; sqlite writes as `sudo -u admin`. Verified: `launchctl asuser 501 sudo -u admin open -ga BlueBubbles` launches into the Aqua session from a root `tailscale ssh` shell.

**Reboot survival**: a `~admin/Library/LaunchAgents/com.yclaw.bluebubbles-launch.plist` (RunAtLoad → `open -ga Messages; sleep; open -ga BlueBubbles`) auto-launches both at login. Full cold-boot verified: autologin → apps launch → helper reconnects → `hermes-agent active`.

**pf**: macOS ships pf DISABLED, so the bluebubbles pf anchors (VNC + bluebubbles-rest) were inert. The `bb-pf-refresh` daemon now runs `pfctl -f /etc/pf.conf` (loads all wired anchors; keeps live states) + `pfctl -e`. Enabling pf is safe: the anchors pass hermes + host on 443/1234 (VNC from tailnet/RFC1918); tailscale-ssh isn't on a blocked port. Test firewall changes on this production node with a dead-man's switch (`nohup sh -c 'sleep 75; pfctl -d' & ; pfctl -e`; cancel once access confirmed).

**Only human step left**: Apple-ID sign-in + iMessage-enable over VNC (device-trust bound, can't be baked into a shared image). The live guest already has it. Tahoe caveats are UPSTREAM (open BlueBubbles issues #776/#779/#814: helper delays/threaded-send stalls) — but the basic helper connects on 26.5. `serve_tailnet` must use the ABSOLUTE `/opt/homebrew/bin/tailscale` (root guest_pipe PATH has no brew dir). See [[macos-guest-vm-ops]], [[bluebubbles-vnc-input-quirks]].
